headline: JSA advises lead investor Panthera Growth Partners on Innefu Labs $30 million Series B fundraise
sum: Innefu Labs Limited has raised $30 million from a Series B fundraise led by Panthera Growth Partners. The fundraise was undertaken through a combination of primary and secondary investments.
detail: Innefu Labs Limited has raised $30 million from a Series B fundraise led by Panthera Growth Partners. The fundraise was undertaken through a combination of primary and secondary investments. JSA Advocates & Solicitors advised Panthera Growth Partners Pte Ltd and its affiliates on this fundraise. The transaction team was led by Siddharth Mody (Partner), with support from Anurag Shrivastav (Partner), Tanmayee Sahoo (Senior Associate) and Atul Mohta (Associate).
